taxonomy.note: Kew POWO (2026 backbone) treats Thelesperma ambiguum as a synonym of accepted Thelesperma megapotamicum var. ambiguum. ITIS still accepts T. ambiguum at species rank. Do not create a canonical learner entry until project taxonomy treatment and exact target-zone county evidence are reconciled.
